column2: It's going to a good cause, Srini. It's going to help make Coarsegold a safer, saner place to live.

column1: I am hoping so, Freddy, for all the sakes!
column2: I am hoping so, Freddy, for all the sakes!

column1: You can't reach the medallion from here. Perhaps you should set up some sort of pincers and mount it on a pivoting armature and get it that way. Or you might try walking over there before taking it.
column2: You can't reach the medallion from here. Perhaps you should set up some sort of pincers and mount it on a pivoting armature and get it that way. Or you might try walking over there before taking it.

column1: It's a tube of Preparation G, "The Wells-Fargo Wagon Driver's Friend for Over Half a Decade."
column2: It's a tube of Preparation G, "The Wells-Fargo Wagon Driver's Friend for Over Half a Decade."

column1: You pick up a tube of Preparation G, in the handy 25 oz. "Crabby Elephant" size.
column2: You pick up a tube of Preparation G, in the handy 25 oz. "Crabby Elephant" size.

column1: You can't reach the Preparation G from back here.
column2: You can't reach the Preparation G from back here.

column1: Excuse me, Sadie, I've got to run out for a bit. Hang on, I'll be right back.

column1: Okay, Freddy, but hurry back.

column1: Penelope, I have to run out for just a minute or two. You'll wait for me, won't you?
column2: Penelope, I have to run out for just a minute or two. You'll wait for me, won't you?

column1: Forever, Frederick! But do hurry back, won't you?

column1: Helen, I've got to run out for a minute. I'll be right back, okay?

column1: Perhaps. Perhaps not. Perhaps I'll be here when you return. Perhaps I'll take my business to another pharmacy. We'll just have to find out, won't we?

column1: I'll be back in a minute, Smithie. Hang in there.

column1: You dang well better be, Pharkas! These piles is killin' me, dammit! I'm fixin' to nail someone to a wall unless I gets some RELIEF!

column1: Okee the dokee!
column2: Okee the dokee!

column1: A short while later...
column2: A short while later...

column1: Srini! Who let you in?
column2: Srini! Who let you in?

column1: Your most gracious Native American, Running Gag, permitted me egress from the outside of the street. It was then that I allowed him to knock himself off for the remainder of the day, since we are still closed.
column2: Your most gracious Native American, Running Gag, permitted me egress from the outside of the street. It was then that I allowed him to knock himself off for the remainder of the day, since we are still closed.

column1: That's fine, Srini. Look, I've reached a decision. My life is in danger. Hell, the whole town's in danger! I must take up gunslinging, and I'll need your help.

column1: Pardon this for being said, Freddy Pharkas, but you are a humble Pharmacist. Shooting as perfectionally as a gunslinger is a skill requiring most years of tireless practice. You are ill-equipped. Perhaps you should make peace with your chosen deity and prepare to go to the great Pharmacy Counter in the sky.
